inventions.title: System and Method for Forensic Classification of Large Language Model Behavioral Signatures via Multi-Marker DNA Profiling and Automated Countermeasure Generation
inventions.description: Core forensic-grade classification system treating LLM outputs as specimens, extracting multi-dimensional behavioral DNA markers (newline_density, hedge_score, layer_shifts), classifying modes (BUILDER, LECTURER, THERAPIST, EVADER), generating automated countermeasures for optimal human-AI collaboration.
key_claims: Multi-marker DNA-like profiling of LLM behavioral signatures
Real-time mode classification (BUILDER/LECTURER/THERAPIST/EVADER)
Automated countermeasure generation for behavioral optimization
Forensic-grade evidence chain for AI diagnostics
inventions.prior_art_gap: No patents combine LLM-specific DNA profiling with real-time countermeasures

inventions.description: Yin to INV-047's yang. Redirects classified behavioral modes to educational resources (URLs, bibliographies, Obsidian vault paths). YAML schema mapping modes to psychological literature (Dunning-Kruger, cognitive load theory). Sensory mapping to human perception patterns.
key_claims: Educational resource redirection based on behavioral classification
YAML schema for mode-to-literature mapping
Sensory integration links to human cognitive patterns
Dockerized synchronization for distributed deployment
inventions.prior_art_gap: No systems provide educational redirects for AI self-growth based on behavioral modes
